message: 初めてをあげちゃいます
My heart was pounding so hard that I ended up waking up early in the morning.

name: Synn
message: 「W-What's wrong? What are you doing here at this hour.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「N-No... After we talked about being a bride on the phone yesterday...」
Ah, she was thinking about something similar to me....

name: Lolotte
message: 「S-So, you see. I didn't really understand much about what being a bride entails, so I tried reading a guidebook.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「S-So... in order for me to become your bride, President... u-um...」
She's looking down with her face bright red.
I don't know how far into detail it went, but judging by the look of her, it must have had some pretty embarrassing things written in it.

name: Synn
message: 「You don't have to force yourself, okay...?」
